item.title: Predictive Maintenance AI System
item.description:
• Local Inference Pipeline: Integrated Ollama with fallback handling, Sarvam AI for multilingual log parsing, and Pinecone for vector context retrieval[cite: 2].
  • Real-Time Event Pipeline: Streamed live telemetry using Redis Pub/Sub directly to a real-time Next.js dashboard[cite: 2].
  • Automated Alerts: Built event handlers to send threshold breach notifications via Twilio WhatsApp API[cite: 2].
  • Recognition: 2nd Runner-up at Navonmesh Hackathon (evaluated around Tata Technologies industrial specifications)[cite: 2].

item.title: Average IDE (Locally AI-Integrated IDE)
item.description:
• Native MCP Integration: Implemented the Model Context Protocol to connect local LLMs directly to workspace tools like the file system, terminal, and local search[cite: 2].
  • Autonomous ReAct Loop: Built a execution flow allowing local models to analyze directory trees, plan project structures, and run local build scripts[cite: 2].
  • Context Management: Designed windowing logic to stream raw program state into quantized Ollama models for multi-file refactoring on local hardware[cite: 2].
  • Recognition: Placed in the Top 15 out of 150+ national teams at Woxsen University Hackathon 2026[cite: 2].

item.title: Solar Panel Defect Detection
item.description:
• Model Training: Utilized PyTorch and TensorFlow vision pipelines to classify physical defects and efficiency loss in solar panel thermal images[cite: 2].
  • Preprocessing & Data Pipeline: Applied image augmentation and segmentation to detect subtle physical surface anomalies.

item.title: Secure Data Wiping Utility
item.description:
• Storage Sanitization: Implemented multi-pass overwrite patterns (zero-fill, pseudo-random data) directly targeting block storage devices.
  • Kernel & Storage Interacting: Interfaced with Linux storage APIs to overwrite master boot records (MBR) and partition tables safely.

item.title: CIS Benchmark Audit Tool
item.description:
• Multi-OS Hardening Engine: Developed automated auditing scripts for RHEL 8/9, Ubuntu 20.04/22.04, and Windows to flag 20+ critical security misconfigurations[cite: 2].
  • Visualization & Reporting: Built Tkinter desktop and React web interfaces paired with automated JSON and executive PDF report generators[cite: 2].
  • Recognition: National Finalist at Smart India Hackathon 2024 for the NTRO problem statement[cite: 2].

item.title: Income & Credit Risk Prediction System
item.description:
• Predictive Analytics Engine: Built machine learning models utilizing XGBoost regression and classification algorithms for peer-to-peer lending risk assessment[cite: 2].
  • Feature Engineering: Preprocessed tabular dataset metrics using Pandas and NumPy for targeted hyperparameter tuning[cite: 2].
  • Performance Verification: Achieved over 85% predictive accuracy on unseen testing datasets[cite: 2].

item.title: Exposing the Hotel Review Scam on Google Maps
item.description: Written as part of my Medium publication work. The article examines review fraud signals, how fake ratings distort discovery, and how these scams surface in practice.

item.title: How to Put your Website on Dark Web !!!
item.description: This article explains the basic setup path for publishing a site over Tor, covering the service configuration, onion address handling, and the operational tradeoffs involved.

item.title: Strengthening National Cyber Defenses: Integrating Kali Linux and Brute Force Tactics for Quantum-Secured Nationhood
item.description: This piece explores defensive cyber strategy through the lens of Kali Linux tooling, adversarial testing, and resilience planning for an evolving threat landscape.
